Joe Swanberg’s Romantic Drama ‘The Sun Never Sets’ Sells Out International Territories as Focus Features Swoops In

London-based sales agency Capture has announced that the romantic drama *The Sun Never Sets*, directed by Joe Swanberg and starring Dakota Fanning, Jake Johnson, and Cory Michael Smith, has officially sold out its international territories following a sweeping raft of deals.

International Distribution and Focus Features Acquisiton

According to details released by Capture, the film has closed a significant series of international sales. Minerva has acquired rights for Italy, NonStop for Scandinavia, NOS for Portugal, Chantier for Turkey, Jucer for the former Yugoslavia, Phoenicia for the Middle East, and Synapse for Latin America. Additionally, Cinesky has picked up rights for international airlines.

Major studio Focus Features has stepped in to acquire the rest of the world—excluding Italy, Scandinavia, Portugal, Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America. Universal Pictures International is set to handle the international distribution on behalf of Focus Features.

Production Background and Plot

Shot on 35mm against the backdrop of Anchorage, Alaska, *The Sun Never Sets* made its world premiere at the 2026 SXSW Film Festival. The feature received previous theatrical releases in the United States via IFC Films and in Canada via Mongrel Media.

Written and directed by Joe Swanberg, whose previous credits include *Drinking Buddies* and *Happy Christmas*, the film centers on a free-spirited woman played by Dakota Fanning. Her seemingly stable relationship with an older, divorced father, portrayed by Jake Johnson, is thrown into question when he suggests a break. The dynamic shifts further when she unexpectedly reconnects with her former boyfriend, played by Cory Michael Smith, creating a complex love triangle that forces her to reevaluate her life and romantic priorities.

The ensemble cast also features Debby Ryan, Anna Konkle, Lamorne Morris, and Karley Sciortino. Production is credited to Swanberg, Fanning, Johnson, Smith, and Ashleigh Snead.

“The Sun Never Sets has been a joy to represent, and the response from international buyers has been fantastic,” said Ella Field, EVP of International Sales at Capture, highlighting the conclusion of their international sales campaign.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For moviegoers and industry observers tracking the film's global rollout, this sales milestone means the romantic drama is locked in for theatrical or platform releases across multiple global regions through its newly minted network of distributors. Because rollout schedules, local release dates, and exhibition formats vary significantly by territory—ranging from major studio windows via Universal and Focus Features to independent regional distributors—audiences should check local cinema listings or regional distributor announcements for specific premiere dates in their respective countries.
